title: Window shockwave
description:
## Intent

Turn @witness's held breath into the measure of the approaching shockwave.

## Composition & Blocking

A **Medium Close-Up** isolates @witness against the threatened window as the fracture brightens behind them.

## Camera & Optics

**Push In** with the held breath on an **85mm lens** with **Shallow Focus**, keeping focus on @witness while the fracture remains a luminous threat.

## End Condition

End when the glass gives way.

optics.intent: Compress the witness against the threatened window

lighting.intent: Cold window light outlining the fracture
